hooks.name: Guard Write Operations
hooks.description: On writes to source paths (apps/, infra/, DB migrations), reminds the agent of the conventions guardrails. Writes to root config, docs, and .kiro/ pass silently.

action.command: INPUT=$(cat); TARGET=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | grep -oE '"(path|targetFile)"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"' | head -n1 | sed -E 's/.*:[[:space:]]*"([^"]*)"/\1/'); case "$TARGET" in */apps/*|apps/*|*/infra/*|infra/*|*migrations/*|*migration/*) echo "Guardrails (.kiro/steering/conventions.md): stay within the work package's declared paths; no PHI in logs or notification bodies; parameterized SQL only; keep immutable records (chat, dose history, authorizations, transfers) append-only; never edit an applied migration (add a new one); no hardcoded secrets or brand name. apps/ = app code; infra/ = Infra agent only.";; *) : ;; esac; exit 0
